               ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', uuidv7(), 'postgres.ordering-successor', 1, 'application/test', ''::bytea, '{}'::jsonb, 'postgres-test-key', now() - interval '2 hours', now() - interval '1 hour', 0)
